newsitem.title: FRANCE: French commandos no longer CRAP -- official.
newsitem.headline: French commandos no longer CRAP -- official.

text.p: An elite unit of France's airborne forces, the CRAP, has changed its name to avoid the sniggers the current acronym unfailingly raised among English-speaking allies, army sources said on Friday.

The "Commandos de Recherche et d'Action en Profondeur" (Long-Range Search and Action Commandos), whose initials meant nothing untoward in French but provoked discreet mirth among allies, will now be known as the "Groupement de Commandos Parachutistes" (Parachute Commando Group) with the innocuous initials GCP.

The 200-man unit, based in southwest France and present in virtually every overseas engagement in which French forces have taken part in the past decade, are the advance reconnaissance unit of the country's elite 11th Parachute Division.

They generally operate in small groups deep behind enemy lines although they acted as a full unit together in the Gulf War when carrying out raids against Iraqi rear areas like their counterparts in the American Special Forces and the British Special Air Service.
"The CRAPs decided to change their name to make it more international, a necessity at a time when a common European defence is slowly taking shape," the Defence Ministry magazine Info-DGA said.
A staff officer confirmed to Reuters that the words "more international" meant getting rid of initials which belied the extremely serious character of the unit.
